deployments_detail.use: Hardie Designer, an AI-powered visualization tool built with Hover letting homeowners instantly apply siding profiles and colors to their home exterior

Hardie Designer — consumer-facing AI tool on jameshardie.com that lets a homeowner upload a single photo of their home and see photorealistic, real-time renderings of Hardie siding products (profiles, colors, textures) in seconds; shareable with contractors. James Hardie is the first siding manufacturer to adopt Hover's flagship design product. [Hover (AI/3D property technology)]
AI Takeoff Estimator — automates the construction blueprint takeoff process to generate material estimates, replacing a manual 2-3 day process. [James Hardie (internally developed)]
deployments_detail.value: reduces a 2-3 day manual process to minutes; ~$500,000 in annual external cost avoidance

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered innovation/idea management — James Hardie runs its Innovation Forum Committee and T.H.I.N.K. program on HYPE Innovation's AI-powered idea management platform to crowdsource, prioritize and advance employee ideas (including the GenAI tools above). [HYPE Innovation]

Hardie Hotline — internally developed AI installation assistant giving field installers real-time, product-specific guidance to reduce installation errors and callbacks. [James Hardie (internally developed)]
deployments_detail.value: 87.7% success rate with ~14-second response time across 5,500+ production tests; ~76% reduction in installation callbacks; ~75% reduction in job-site downtime; $5.1M-$7.3M annual cost avoidance through reduced rework

deployments_detail.use: JH Lab Assistant — AI tool that guides R&D lab workflows and standard operating procedures for research operations, speeding execution and onboarding. [James Hardie (internally developed)]
deployments_detail.value: up to 50% faster execution; 30% faster onboarding; ~$4,000 annual productivity gain per user

deployments_detail.use: AI Cutting Planner — optimizes on-site installation efficiency and cutting layout to reduce measurement time and minimize material waste. [James Hardie (internally developed)]
